title: Review the day's footage and send the wrap report
purpose: Nothing the client must never see goes out, every bad cycle gets a fix, and Mano has the number.
when: 5:00 PM every shift, Friday included at hotels that keep running.

steps.do: Take the handover from the operator.
steps.check: The count matches this morning's number.

steps.do: Watch every session against the wearer log.
steps.detail: Hands and work in frame, good light, real work for 30 minutes.

steps.do: Check each session against the eight fraud patterns.
steps.check: Each problem has device number, wearer, pattern, and minute.

steps.do: Delete anything the client must never see.
steps.detail: Restrooms, screens, ID documents, anyone under 18. Before it uploads.
steps.check: Youssef Medhat has the list tonight.

steps.do: Write a correction for every problem.
steps.detail: Plain words, said before the wearer's first cycle tomorrow.
On the site's line, or with the runner in the provided bag.
steps.check: Every phone is uploading or signed for.

steps.detail: Hours, active phones, hardware status, problems, fixes worth copying. From the sheet, not memory.

steps.do: If the site is below target, call Moharam.
steps.detail: Bring the cause and the fix.

done: By 6:00 PM every session is watched, every correction written, and Mano has the five lines.

fails.if: A phone is short at the handover
fails.then: Lost mode within the hour. Tell Moharam and Mano the same hour.
Call Moharam the same hour. A hub run goes out before 11 PM.

fails.if: You are not sure a session is fraud
fails.then: Youssef Medhat decides tonight. Nobody guesses.
Pull the phone now. Tell Youssef Medhat the same hour, Mano the same day.

fails.if: Mano has not answered by the sync
fails.then: Send the five lines to Moharam.

escalate: Moharam the same hour if a phone is short or the site cannot upload. Youssef Medhat for videos.
